summary: United Fire Group filed an 8-K reporting the board's appointment of Teresa J. Brown as a Class C independent director effective August 21, 2026, with seats on the Risk Management and Audit Committees and a 2027 annual meeting stand-for-election. The board also declared a routine $0.20 per share quarterly cash dividend payable September 18, 2026 to holders of record September 4, 2026. No deal, stake, premium, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are present; this is an ordinary current report covering governance and capital-return housekeeping items. Watch only for routine 10-Q/dividend continuity; no risk-arb angle applies.
